blurb: Guests can visit the brewery to enjoy craft beers including gluten-free and non-alcoholic options. The brewery has multiple locations with private event rental spaces suitable for parties, corporate events, and community gatherings. They host weekly community support events called Bleating Heart Nights where proceeds support local organizations.
